name: Olamide Voss-Reinholt
description: The most commercially dominant neural-feed actor of his generation, Olamide Voss-Reinholt holds an exclusive Tier-A contract with Vantablack Media that prohibits him from accepting any independent or underground work. His neural signature — a distinctive warmth layered over barely-suppressed grief — became so recognizable that audiences began calling the sensation 'the Voss feeling,' a phrase that entered common usage. He has not spoken publicly about his contract terms since 2209.
cultural_impact: The phrase 'the Voss feeling' entered Meridian slang as shorthand for comfort that costs something — warmth you didn't consent to needing.
story_hooks: A fan claims to have received an encrypted message from Voss-Reinholt asking for help escaping his contract — but the message could be a Vantablack honeypot.
A pirate mesh circulates an unauthorized neural sample of Voss-Reinholt's unfiltered emotional feed from a session he thought was private.
A player is hired to courier a physical document to Voss-Reinholt — a document he clearly wants destroyed before his handlers see it.
